title: Pushforward of a quasi-coherent module along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the pushforward f_*F of a quasi-coherent O_X-module is quasi-coherent (source lines 2123-2130). Quasi-coherence on an algebraic space is tested on affine schemes etale over the base, so the proof base changes along V -> Y, reduces to Y affine, chooses an affine etale cover U -> X, and uses the exact sequence 0 -> f_*F -> a_*(F|_U) -> b_*(F|_R) with R = U x_X U; quasi-separatedness of f makes R a quasi-compact separated scheme and a, b quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so the scheme case of the quasi-coherence of pushforwards applies to both terms and f_*F is exhibited as a kernel of quasi-coherent modules.
